reviews.comment: Dr petersen's class was great, she is very helpful and trys her best to make sure you do well in her class. Will explain topic to you if you dont understand. also gives extra credit oppertunities. Labs fun are easy. Exams are easy she will give you partial credit on the Qs if she know what you were trying to answer if its not exact.

She is very nice and goes out of her way to make sure you succeed in her class. Lectures are easy to understand, she is available to answer any questions about the lecture material, she gives at least extra credit opportunity. The only grades in this class are exams, but they are easy.

Dr. Petersen is an amazing woman that just wants to see her students succeed. She is extremely understanding, offers multiple extra credit opportunities, and gives in class review sheets that prepares you for every exam. I recommend going to lectures because it would be beneficial but it isn't necessary to pass the class.

Dr. Petersen was phenomenal. I took 3 of her classes back to back and I loved each one. I had a huge family emergency during one semester and she worked around my schedule to get the tests to me. Super thoughtful and caring. Ive told serval people that I learned more in her 3 classes I took than ALL the other classes at TAMUG combined.
Dr. Petersen is awesome! Do the test reviews and you're solid.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor. I would take her again in a heart beat. Gives great exam reviews and truly want's every student to be successful. Gave us extra credit worth a great portion of our lecture average and test had extra credit opportunities.

While she isn't the regular teacher for vert, she was a very good substitute. I thoroughly enjoyed her. BTW don't bother writing notes: just edit the ppt's she puts up. She gives you exactly what's on the test, and works with you in grading it. For lab, just make sure you keep up with the notebook and study your heart out for the first practical.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY
